text:
maria: quick FYI, i'm about to land a terraform change that allowlists a small set of k8s service accounts to call kms:Decrypt for our secrets-sidecar key. low risk but would appreciate a quick look.
Tariq: pinged. can you paste the tf snippet you're planning to apply? want to check principal format + condition keys.
maria: sure — plan is to create a customer-managed key policy + a separate kms_key_grant resource tied to the IRSA role ARNs. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_kms_grant" "svcacct_decrypt" {
  name              = "svcacct-decrypt-grant"
  key_id            = aws_kms_key.secrets.id
  grantee_principal = var.irsa_role_arns[count.index]
  operations        = ["Decrypt"]
  constraints = {
    encryption_context_subset = {
      "aws:rep:secret-pair" = "*app-config*"
    }
  }
}
```
maria: also using a small allowlist map in tfvars for accepted svcacct prefixes like "team-a-" and specific namespaces.
sam: couple quick thoughts —
1) aws_kms_grant requires the grantee principal to be an AWS principal (role/service), IRSA works if the role ARN is used — ok.
2) For cross-account IRSA role ARNs double-check the key policy has the same account ID or a proper principal entry.
kevin: encryption_context_subset is neat but be careful: not all SDKs reliably send encryption context on decrypt. any chance the sidecar misses it? would prefer a condition using aws:PrincipalTag if we tag the role with svcacct-name.
maria: good call. the sidecar sets EncryptionContext in our code path, but i can add aws:PrincipalTag fallback. how do we reference tags in tf for role arn principal condition?
Tariq: you'd add a KeyPolicy statement like:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-irsa-role"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/svcacct": "team-a"}}
}
```
Tariq: But remember: KeyPolicy condition supports principal tags only when using IAM principal (role) not for assumed-role with STS? Actually tags on roles are passed through with STS if session tags are used. For IRSA we control the session tags via the kube2iam/IRSA setup? need to check.
sam: IRSA (OIDC) can map k8s serviceaccount annotations to role session tags via sts:TagSession on AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity if the role allows it. So add sts:TagSession permission and ensure the token provider includes tags.
maria: aha — we don't currently tag sessions. our helm chart for the sidecar could add annotation to request session tags. i'll file a follow-up to add that. for now i'll keep encryption_context_subset and add a fallback PrincipalArn allowlist.
kevin: also confirm terraform plan doesn't attempt to rotate the key or blow away existing grants. I've seen aws_kms_grant get recreated when the principal ARN is interpolated differently. use lifecycle ignore_changes if needed.
maria: good point. i added lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } and explicit depends_on to avoid plan churn. i'll post the full plan output here shortly.
infra-bot: terraform plan finished for branch "svcacct-kms-allowlist": 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy — no drift detected.
Tariq: looks fine from my side. small nits: update module README to document the required svcacct annotation and add a test manifest for staging.
maria: will do. merging in ~30m unless anyone raises a blocker. thanks all :rocket:
